purpose: Initial source-led records for the H2 Wellness Hub directory. Records are navigation aids, not endorsements or medical claims.

resources.title_en: PubMed: molecular hydrogen clinical and randomized studies
resources.title_zh: PubMed：分子氢临床与随机研究检索
resources.summary_en: A reusable, date-sorted discovery query for molecular hydrogen, hydrogen-rich water, and hydrogen-inhalation clinical or randomized literature.
resources.source_note: Search results require study-by-study review; a database match is not a treatment or product-efficacy determination.

resources.summary_en: Official registry search for global studies that use the term molecular hydrogen.
resources.source_note: Registration does not establish quality, efficacy, regulatory clearance, or availability.

resources.title_en: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 520: Hydrogen gas
resources.summary_en: A U.S. food-use regulatory record relevant to a defined intended use of hydrogen gas in beverages.
resources.source_note: This is not FDA approval of disease treatment, any hydrogen-water brand, or any device claim.

resources.title_en: Japan Registry of Clinical Trials portal
resources.title_zh: 日本临床研究检索门户
resources.source_type: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare system
resources.summary_en: Official Japanese trial-search portal; use Japanese queries such as 水素, 水素吸入, and 水素ガス.
resources.source_note: Registry entries must be read at study level; listing is not an efficacy assessment.

resources.title_zh: J-STAGE 日本学术期刊平台
resources.source_type: Japan Science and Technology Agency platform
resources.summary_en: Japanese journal platform for source discovery. Useful queries include 分子状水素, 水素吸入, and 水素水.
resources.source_note: Journal and study quality must be reviewed individually.

resources.title_en: Japanese Molecular Hydrogen Medical Biology Society
resources.title_zh: 日本分子状氢医学生物学会
resources.summary_en: Japanese specialist academic organization and event source for molecular hydrogen medicine terminology and activity.
resources.source_note: An academic organization is not a regulator or product-certification body.

resources.title_zh: NITE/IAJapan JNLA 认可实验室目录
resources.summary_en: A navigation tool for locating accredited Japanese laboratories and checking the exact scope of accreditation.
resources.source_note: Accreditation applies only to a listed scope and does not automatically cover dissolved-hydrogen testing or medical safety.
